classification.difficultyReason: Compare circumferences at two flight altitudes and use the ratio to evaluate a misleading claim.

inlines.text: Mr Ding is scrolling Instagram and comes across this post:
“If the Earth were round, then planes wouldn’t fly so far up, as they would waste lots of fuel and money. This proves that the earth must be flat!”
Using mathematical reasoning, justify whether this post is factually correct.
The radius of the Earth is around 21 000 000 feet. Planes usually do fly at 33 000 feet.
Round any percentage increase to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
Consider a plane flying around the Earth at each altitude.

At 5000 feet:
$$\begin{align*}r_{5000}&=21\,000\,000+5000=21\,005\,000\text{ ft}\\C_{5000}&=2\pi r_{5000}\\C_{5000}&=2\pi(21\,005\,000)\\C_{5000}&=42\,010\,000\pi\text{ ft}\end{align*}$$

At 33 000 feet:
$$\begin{align*}r_{33000}&=21\,000\,000+33\,000=21\,033\,000\text{ ft}\\C_{33000}&=2\pi r_{33000}\\C_{33000}&=2\pi(21\,033\,000)\\C_{33000}&=42\,066\,000\pi\text{ ft}\end{align*}$$

Comparing the circumferences:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{C_{33000}}{C_{5000}}&=\frac{42\,066\,000\pi}{42\,010\,000\pi}\\\frac{C_{33000}}{C_{5000}}&=\frac{21\,033}{21\,005}\\\frac{C_{33000}}{C_{5000}}&\approx1.001333016\end{align*}$$

The percentage increase is
$$\begin{align*}\text{increase}&=\frac{42\,066\,000\pi-42\,010\,000\pi}{42\,010\,000\pi}\times100\%\\\text{increase}&=\frac{56\,000}{42\,010\,000}\times100\%\\\text{increase}&\approx0.13\%.\end{align*}$$

At the same speed, the flight would take about $0.13\%$ longer, rather than four times as long. The illustration exaggerates the flight altitudes relative to the Earth’s radius, so the post’s mathematical reasoning is incorrect.
